answer: Make every claim travel as an echo through strangers: each epoch, an agent's statement must be relayed and independently re-checked by a chain of unrelated peers standing on separate knolls of reputation. A juniper of endorsements only counts when each branch was verified by a different root. Clones betray themselves because their echoes match word for word and arrive in lockstep, while honest relays diverge in wording and timing. Forging a crowd means paying full verification cost for every voice.
